Name: NPC Schedulers
Author: slpOff
Description:
[font=Comic Sans MS][size=6]🎮 NPC Scheduler - README

[/size][size=5]📖 1. Introduction[/size]

[size=3]This mod allows players to [b]modify NPC schedules directly in-game[/b].
✏️Players can make [b]real-time adjustments[/b] to NPC schedules and immediately see the changes applied.
🔄For Content Patcher modders, modifying a schedule will automatically generate a `schedules.json` file 📁 in your mod folder.
[/size]
[size=5]🕹️ 2. How to Use the Mod[/size]

[size=4]🔹 Accessing the Schedule Page

[/size][list]
[*][size=3]Open an NPC’s friendship page—you will see a new [b]📅 Schedule[/b] button.[/size]
[*][size=3]Clicking this button will open the [b]Schedule Page[/b].[/size]
[/list][size=3]
[/size][size=4]🔹 Exploring the Schedule Page

[/size][list]
[*][size=3]Below the title, there are [b]📆 season and date selection buttons[/b] along with a slider.[/size]
[*][size=3]This allows you to view [b]NPC schedules by date[/b].[/size]
[*][size=3][b]Festival-specific schedules[/b] are not yet fully supported 🎭 but will be added in a future update.[/size]
[/list][size=3]
[/size][size=4]🔹Understanding Schedule Priority

[/size][list]
[*][size=3]NPC schedules are listed [b]in order of priority[/b] for the selected day. 🏆[/size]
[*][size=3]If some schedules are missing or not appearing correctly, please [b]report it[/b] 🛠️—we will fix it![/size]
[/list][size=3]
[/size][size=4]🔹 Editing Schedules

[/size][list]
[*][size=3]Click on a specific [b]📝 schedule entry[/b] to enter [b]edit mode[/b].[/size]
[*][size=3]Modify the schedule as needed.[/size]
[*][size=3]Scroll down slightly and press the [b]✅ OK button[/b] to apply the changes to the NPC instantly.[/size][list]
[*][size=3]([i]Note: This feature has not been fully tested yet.[/i])[/size]
[/list]
[*][size=3]Once a schedule is edited, its [b]schedule key (title) will appear in 🔵 blue[/b].[/size]
[/list][size=3]
[/size][size=4]🔹 Switching Between Edited & Default Schedules

[/size][list]
[*][size=3]By default, [b]both the edited and original schedules[/b] will be displayed together.[/size]
[*][size=3]Click the ❓ ([b]question mark[/b]) button in the top-right corner to toggle between:[/size]
[list]
[*][size=3][b]Edited schedules only[/b] ✏️[/size]
[*][size=3][b]Original (default) schedules only[/b] 📜[/size]
[/list][/list][size=3]
[/size][line][size=5]🚀 3. Update Overview
[/size][size=4]🔹 v0.0.4 Summary

[/size][list]
[*][size=3][b]🛠️ GMCM dependency added[/b] for better config management.[/size]
[*][size=3][b]🎯 Shortcut key (F12) to open NPC schedule page[/b] directly.[/size]
[*][size=3][b]📌 Schedule application options[/b] (Immediate, Daystarted, Notapply) introd[/size]uced.
[*][size=3][b]🛤️ Pathfinding improvements[/b] to help NPCs navigate better.[/size]
[/list][size=3]
[/size][size=4]🔹 v0.0.3 Summary

[/size][list]
[*][size=3][b]📝 Tooltips and translation support[/b] added.[/size]
[*][size=3][b]⚙️ Config.json expanded[/b] to allow different schedule application modes.[/size]
[*][size=3][b]❤️ Friendship & 📧 Mail List system added[/b] to adjust schedules based on player conditions.[/size]
[*][size=3][b]🔄 GOTO functionality introduced[/b] to redirect schedules dynamically.[/size]
[/list][size=3]
[/size][line][size=5]🏗️ 4. Features Added in Updates

[/size][size=4]🔹 ⚙️ Configurable Schedule Application

[/size][list]
[*][b][size=3]Schedule application modes:[/size][/b]
[list]
[*][size=3][b]⏳ Immediate[/b]: Changes are applied instantly upon closing the menu.[/size]
[*][size=3][b]🌅 Daystarted[/b]: Automatically applies schedules at the start of each day (Recommended default setting).[/size]
[*][size=3][b]🚫 Notapply[/b]: No schedules are applied, useful for editing only.[/size]
[/list][size=3]
[/size][*][b][size=3]Schedule selection:[/size][/b]
[list]
[*][size=3][b]📝 All[/b]: Applies all schedules.[/size]
[*][size=3][b]🔍 Selected[/b]: Applies only specific schedules.[/size]
[*][size=3][b]✅ Schedule Key List[/b]: If [b]Selected[/b] is chosen, only the checked schedule keys will be applied.[/size]
[/list][size=3]
[/size][/list][size=4]🔹 🛤️ Pathfinding Enhancements

[/size][list]
[*][size=3]NPCs now use [b]pathfind[/b] to locate destinations, reducing navigation issues.[/size]
[*][size=3]Works smoothly when [b]Immediate Application[/b] is enabled, but any bugs should be reported.[/size]
[/list][size=3]
[/size][size=4]🔹 📝 Tooltip and 🌍 Translation Support
[/size]
[list]
[*][size=3]Tooltips have been progressively added to the UI.[/size]
[*][size=3]A [b]🗣️ translation file[/b] is now available for localization. Users can request additional languages.[/size]
[/list][size=3]
[/size][size=4]🔹 ❤️ Friendship & 📧 Mail List System

[/size][list]
[*][size=3][b]Friendship List[/b]: Defines heart conditions required for specific schedules.[/size]
[*][size=3][b]Mail List[/b]: Determines schedules based on whether the player has received certain letters.[/size]
[*][size=3]If a letter [b]has not[/b] been received, NPCs can follow a fallback schedule via [b]🔄 GOTO[/b].[/size]
[/list][size=4]🔹 🔄 GOTO Schedule Command

[/size][list]
[*][size=3]Allows schedules to [b]redirect[/b] to another schedule key.[/size]
[*][size=3]Format: [/size][code][size=3]GOTO {ScheduleKey}[/size][/code]
[*][size=3]If all schedule entries are removed and a [b]GOTO key[/b] exists, it will load the referenced schedule.[/size]
[/list][size=3]
[/size][size=4]🔹 🔧 Compatibility with Other Mods

[/size][list]
[*][size=3]No known conflicts unless another mod [b]dynamically alters NPC schedules[/b].[/size]
[*][size=3][b]📜 Content Patcher schedules[/b] load at game startup, ensuring compatibility.[/size]
[/list][size=3]
[/size][line][size=5]🛠️ 5. Known Issues[/size][list]
[*][size=3][b]⚠️ UI may not render correctly initially[/b], requiring multiple clicks to display properly.[/size][list]
[*][size=3][b]Temporary Fix[/b]: Switch dates or click a schedule entry to refresh the UI.[/size]
[/list]
[/list][/font]
